loaderOrder: Loader order: gate -> NAM model -> bus comp

stages.hardware: Gate FIRST in the chain, keyed on the guitar (DI) before any pedal: open at -55 dB, close at -61 dB (hysteresis 6 dB), attack 0.5 ms, hold 20 ms, release 60 ms, range -90 dB.

Bus compressor LAST (after the cab / post EQ): threshold -14 dB re the chain's pre-headroom level = -14 dB re 0 dBFS at the exported output, ratio 2:1, attack 10 ms, release 120 ms, knee 6 dB, make-up +0.0 dB, peak detector.

settings.thresholdReference: pre-headroom chain level (the 6 dB sum headroom is not counted)
